<!-- pr-reviewer: b05f1318caa69da1c4313987955f8f2a636d0e30 -->
**Needs changes before merge.**

Thank you for this fix. The direction is good: the clean-up passes now get a measurement at the 90.0 deg default too. But the PR removes an existing refusal, it adds `expect()` calls on a user path, and the new diagnostic is not pinned end to end. Details follow.

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes trochoidal toolpath generation (posted G-code) under a `P1` issue.

### What looks good

- `plan_cleanup_checked` measures the clean-up chains against a post-lane stock model, also at the 90.0 deg default.
- `Warning::EngagementExceeded` is advisory, it has an MCP kind (`engagement_exceeded`) and its own status-line group.
- No recorded program changed. `golden_cl`, `example_catalog*` and `solid_law_goldens` are green, so the goldens stay byte-identical as the body says.
- Clippy is clean on `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-sim`, `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui`.

### Results (locally, trial merge with upstream/main `baad348f1`)

The merge with main is clean. The host is macOS; the UI suites ran (a GPU adapter is present).

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| build `-p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --tests` | ok |
| motion `--test adaptive_troch_clean` (pin) | 2 passed (55.4 s in debug) |
| motion `--lib` | 666 passed, 22 ignored |
| motion `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, `pocket3d_troch`, `golden_undercut`, `trochoid_slot` | all passed |
| sim `--lib` | 265 passed |
| app `adaptive_trochoid`, `pocket3d_trochoid`, `trochoid_confine`, `trochoid_law`, `trochoid_op`, `warned_moves` | 13, 5, 6, 7, 5, 2 passed |
| app `golden_cl`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `solid_law_goldens`, `strategy_fallback`, `verify` | 43, 1, 34, 7, 1, 21 passed |
| ui `--lib` (cwd `crates/ui`) | 1668 passed, 8 ignored |
| ui `--test operations` | 31 passed |
| clippy `-D warnings` (motion, sim, app, ui; `--all-targets`) | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps, 0 failed |
| targeted heavy, release `--ignored`: motion `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, motion lib `adaptive_troch` | 2, 3, 2, 12 passed |

I did not run the full 324-step quick plan. The body reports it green on `b0169b4d1`. The steps above are the suites that the diff reaches through trochoidal code, goldens, the catalog and the warning fold.

Extra suites run: none owed. The diff does not touch `testdata/` or the importers.

### Mutations (run by the reviewer)

| Mutation | Result | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| M1: `CLEANUP_LADDER = &[1.0]` (no step-down) | green | The step-down is not pinned. The pin passes on the warning path (64.0 deg, warned). |
| M2: M1 and no `cleanup_engagement_note` in `adaptive_troch.rs` | red: `wide 30x24 D6 (60 deg): engagement 64.0 deg exceeds 60.0 deg without a named warning` | The 2D note is pinned. Good. |
| M3: remove `warns.extend(cleanup_engagement_warning(&path))` in `generate.rs` | green (`adaptive_trochoid`, `warned_moves`) | The operation and status-line warning is not pinned. |

### Requested before merge

1. **A refusal is removed without a decision.** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch.rs:252` (old `upstream/main` lines 243-255). On main, a custom limit (`max_engagement != DEFAULT_MAX_ENGAGEMENT`) measured the WHOLE path (lanes, links, clean-up, all levels) and refused it with `GenError::Invalid` above the limit. The PR deletes that check. The new check covers only the clean-up chains on one level, and it is advisory. So a lane or link overload under a custom limit now posts with no diagnostic. The body calls this "removing the skip", but it removes a refusal. Do one of these:
   - keep a whole-path measurement for each limit (as a refusal, or as the advisory warning with the measured value), or
   - show with a test that lanes and links cannot exceed the limit, and record the change from refusal to advisory in `docs/decisions/3849-<slug>.md` (AGENTS.md "Every recommendation is recorded").
2. **`expect()` on a user path.** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_clean.rs:199`, `:241` and `:270` call `expect()` in non-test code. AGENTS.md "Prime Directive" forbids this. Also `:248` indexes `chains[0].pts[0]`, which panics if a chain has no points. Restructure the loop so that the baseline candidate is a plain value (for example, keep `best` as the baseline result before the loop), and use `first()` with an error or a skip for the index.
3. **The status-line warning is not pinned end to end (M3).** `crates/app/tests/adaptive_trochoid.rs:445` builds a synthetic `Toolpath` and calls `cleanup_engagement_warning` directly. The real generation half only asserts that no warning blocks the post. Add a test that generates a real 2D (and a 3D) Trochoidal operation whose clean-up exceeds the limit, and assert that `Warning::EngagementExceeded` is in the cached warnings. The 3D path (`crates/motion/src/machining3d/troch.rs:146`) has no pin at all.
4. **The step-down is not pinned (M1).** No test fails when the ladder is only `[1.0]`. Add an assert that a fixture which exceeds at scale 1.0 holds the limit after step-down, with the "peel step was reduced" note and no `EngagementExceeded`.
5. **The pin is not red first on main for the defect of the issue.** Issue #3849 asks for a pin that is red on main. On main the 60 deg cases are refused (`GenError::Invalid`), not passed silently. The 90 deg `face` case stays at or below 90 deg on main. So the test comment at `crates/motion/tests/adaptive_troch_clean.rs:42-44` ("never stepped cleanup down or surfaced a warning") is not correct. Correct the comment. Add a 90 deg fixture that exceeds silently on main, or say in the body that you found none.
6. **The warning names the wrong move.** `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:72-76` sets `at` to the first non-rapid move of the whole path. That is the first lane cut, not the clean-up pass. The text "from move {at}" and the move highlight (`warned_moves.rs`) then point to the wrong place. Record the move index (or find the move nearest to the measured XY of the note) and use it for `at`.
7. **UI change without screenshots.** `crates/ui/src/operations.rs:323` adds a new status-line group. The body has no before/after screenshots. Add them to the PR body. Put the images on an images-only branch and link them; do not commit them to this branch.
8. **New top-level test binary.** `crates/motion/tests/adaptive_troch_clean.rs` is a new top-level file. AGENTS.md "New tests join a directory suite" asks for an existing directory suite, or a one-line reason in the body. The body has no reason. Also, this test takes 55 s in debug here, near the 60 s limit for the default lane.
9. **400-line file.** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_clean.rs` grows to 431 lines. Move `plan_cleanup_checked` and the note helpers to a file of their own (AGENTS.md "400-line files").
10. **The body does not name the targeted heavy step.** A `P1` PR under the safety floor names its targeted heavy step in the body (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review"). The reviewer ran the motion trochoidal heavy tests above, and they are green on this head. Add the step and its result to the body after the next push.

### Notes (not blocking)

- `plan_cleanup_checked` simulates the lane path again for each ladder step (`make_post_lane_stock` in the loop), and in 3D this occurs for each level. Simulate the lanes one time and clone the stock.
- In the 3D path, the error texts in `plan_cleanup_checked` say "2D Adaptive (Trochoidal): measuring stock". Use the caller's name.
- The measurement now runs at the 90.0 deg default for each 2D and 3D trochoidal generation. The suite times above did not show a large change, but a heavy fixture can take longer.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

@paulsvc, this P1 has waited since the last review, so we are helping with a fixup on this branch (maintainer edits are allowed). It addresses the six requested items of the last review:
1. the removed refusal for a custom `max_engagement` (keep it, or record the decision),
2. the `expect()` calls in `adaptive_troch_clean.rs` (no panics on a user path),
3. an end-to-end pin of the status-line warning through the real generator,
4. a pin of the step-down ladder,
5. a pin that is red on main for the defect of #3849,
6. the warning naming the clean-up move, not the first lane cut.

We merge (never rebase) and post an "Addressed:" comment with the commits and gate results. If you are already working on it, say so here and we stop.

Addressed: the six requested items of the review on `b05f1318c`. New head: `947b907a7` (one commit, a plain push, no merge of main was necessary: `git merge-tree` with `upstream/main` is clean).

1. **The removed refusal.** The whole-path refusal for a custom `max_engagement` is back in `adaptive_troch.rs`, as on `upstream/main`. The clean-up check only steps the peel down before it. The advisory warning now applies only at the 90.0 deg default, where main measured nothing. The decision is in `docs/decisions/3849-trochoidal-cleanup-engagement.md`.
   - Pin: `motion adaptive_troch_clean::a_custom_limit_the_whole_path_cannot_hold_is_refused` (notch pocket, 75 deg, refused at about 95.5 deg). No test pinned this refusal on main.
2. **`expect()` on a user path.** The check moved to `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_check.rs`. It has no `expect()` and no unchecked index. The baseline is a plain value before the loop, and `first_point()` reads the first chain point with `first()`. A ladder step with no point is skipped. This also moves `adaptive_troch_clean.rs` under 400 lines (285; the new file is 235), which was item 9.
3. **End-to-end warning pin.** The real generator cuts a 20 x 14 pocket with a 7 mm notch (6 mm tool, 90 deg default). The cached warnings carry `Warning::EngagementExceeded`, and no warning holds the post.
   - 2D: `app adaptive_trochoid::an_over_limit_cleanup_warns_on_its_own_move_through_the_real_generator`
   - 3D: `app pocket3d_trochoid::an_over_limit_cleanup_level_warns_on_its_own_move`
   - M3 (remove `warns.extend(cleanup_engagement_warning(&path))`): both tests go red.
4. **Step-down pin.** At the full peel step, `wide 30x24 D6` and `L-shape D10` read 64.0 and 62.5 deg against 60 deg. Now they step down, post, and carry the "peel step was reduced" note with no `EngagementExceeded`.
   - `motion adaptive_troch_clean::cleanup_steps_down_to_a_custom_limit_wide`, `..._l_shape`
   - `app adaptive_trochoid::a_custom_limit_cleanup_steps_down_and_posts_without_a_warning`
   - M1 (`CLEANUP_LADDER = &[1.0]`): all three go red (the restored refusal fires).
5. **Red on main.** The test comment is corrected: main refused the 60 deg cases, it did not pass them silently. The new 90 deg fixture is the notch pocket. On `upstream/main` its clean-up reads 118.5 deg with no note. I ran the same check against main's motion sources, and it failed: `engagement 118.5 deg exceeds 90.0 deg without a named warning`. On this head the clean-up steps down to 97.5 deg and is named.
   - Pin: `motion adaptive_troch_clean::cleanup_over_the_default_limit_is_named`
6. **The warning names the clean-up move.** The note now carries the level Z: `at (x, y, z)`. `cleanup_engagement_move` finds the feed at that Z that passes nearest the measured peak. Of equal moves it takes the last, because the clean-up comes after the lanes of its level. `generate.rs` uses that index for `at`.
   - Pins: `app adaptive_trochoid::cleanup_engagement_warning_names_the_feed_through_the_peak` (synthetic path), and the two end-to-end tests above. They assert that `at` is after the first cut and is a feed in the notch.
   - Mutation (back to the first non-rapid move): the synthetic test and the 2D and 3D end-to-end tests go red.

Each mutation was reverted, and the pins are green again on `947b907a7`.

**Test times (debug).** Each new or split test is under 60 s when it runs alone. The motion file is now six tests, not one long test.

**Gate on `947b907a7`.**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 322 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (38.0 min).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Targeted heavy (release, `--ignored`): `cargo xtask gate heavy --only "motion heavy: adaptive_troch_clean|island|neck|parallel"`: 4 steps, 0 failed (2.0 min). `cargo test --release -p camcraft-motion --lib adaptive_troch -- --ignored`: 12 passed.

**Not done in this round** (not in the six items): the screenshots (item 7), the reason line for the top-level test binary (item 8) and the PR body update (item 10). These are for the author or the next round.

**Note (outside this PR):** at the 90 deg default, a "vee" pocket (40 x 30 with a V cut into its top wall, 6 mm tool) measured 113.5 deg on the whole path with no clean-up note. The peak is not in the clean-up, so it is probably a lane or a link. Main does not measure lanes at the default limit either. This needs its own issue.

Please re-review.

**Needs changes before merge: three earlier findings remain open.**

The code fixes pass the local checks. The missing items are PR evidence and the test-binary reason. No new blocker was found.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes trochoidal toolpath generation. I read the full diff and the fix commit. I checked the laws against upstream/main's current `AGENTS.md`.

### Earlier findings

The earlier review is [here](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4008#issuecomment-7163313568). The [Addressed comment](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4008#issuecomment-7176477149) names fix commit `947b907a71e6b3015d94d8b52691d63a34b7b641`.

| Earlier item | Status and evidence |
|---|---|
| 1. Removed custom-limit refusal | Fixed. `adaptive_troch.rs` keeps the whole-path refusal. The custom-limit refusal test passes. The decision file records the choice. |
| 2. Panics in the new check | Fixed. `adaptive_troch_check.rs` uses a baseline value and `first_point()`. The reported `expect()` calls and index are removed. |
| 3. Cached warning tests | Fixed. Real 2D and 3D generator tests pass. Both fail when I remove warning promotion. See M3 below. |
| 4. Step-down test | Fixed. Both custom-limit fixtures pass. Both fail when I remove the smaller ladder steps. See M1 below. |
| 5. Failure on main | Fixed. The comment is corrected. My notch probe fails on bare main at 118.5 deg without a warning. The PR's default-limit test passes. |
| 6. Wrong warning move | Fixed. The note carries Z. The nearest-feed selection and the synthetic, 2D, and 3D tests pass. |
| 7. UI screenshots | Not fixed. The body has no before/after screenshots. |
| 8. Separate test binary | Not fixed. The body gives no reason for the new top-level test binary. |
| 9. File length | Fixed. The check moved to its own 235-line file. `adaptive_troch_clean.rs` has 285 lines. |
| 10. Targeted heavy result in body | Not fixed. The body still names the old head and has no targeted heavy result. The fixup comment has results, but the body does not. |

### Local results

All checks ran locally on Linux. No GitHub runner was used.

Trial merge: `7bb6ed454583d9f987dcbbfc699f05336e04a85e`.
Base: upstream/main `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c`.
`HEAD^1` is the full PR head named above. The merge is clean.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 325 steps; 0 failed; 0 stalled; 39.8 min |
| sim / motion / app library tests | 266 / 705 / 313 passed; motion has 22 ignored |

**Extra suites run:** None required by the extra fixture/importer rules. This diff changes no fixture directory, `testdata/`, or importer.

### Reviewer mutations

| Mutation | Result | Restored control |
|---|---|---|
| M1: set `CLEANUP_LADDER` to `&[1.0]` | Both `cleanup_steps_down_to_a_custom_limit_*` tests fail. The refusals report 62.5 and 64.0 deg against 60 deg. | Both pass. |
| M3: remove `warns.extend(cleanup_engagement_warning(&path))` | The real 2D and 3D warning tests each fail with no `EngagementExceeded`. I ran the 3D mutation separately after Cargo stopped at the 2D failure. | Both pass. |

I also ran a temporary notch probe on bare upstream/main. It failed with `engagement 118.5 deg exceeds 90.0 deg without a named warning`. After restoration, `cleanup_over_the_default_limit_is_named` passed on the PR trial merge.

### Requested before merge

1. **Earlier item 7:** `crates/ui/src/operations.rs:324` changes the status-line warning group. Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Put the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body.
2. **Earlier item 8:** `crates/motion/tests/adaptive_troch_clean.rs:1` adds a top-level test binary. Add the one-line reason required by **New tests join a directory suite**, or move the tests into an existing suite.

Addressed: the three open items of the review on `947b907a7` (items 7, 8 and 10). New head: `f7d795b0c` (one commit, a plain push, no merge of main).

@paulsvc, please paste the screenshot table and the Verification section below into the PR body. If you prefer, reply here and we paste them for you. Then a collaborator re-review can clear the items.

### Item 7: before/after screenshots

An off-screen render made the images (`egui_kittest` and headless `wgpu`, the same harness as `cargo xtask docs-images`). No window opened. The fixture is the notch pocket of `an_over_limit_cleanup_warns_on_its_own_move_through_the_real_generator`: a 20 x 14 pocket with a 7 mm notch, a 6 mm end mill, Trochoidal, the 90 deg default. Each image regenerates operation A1 and expands the status banner of the Properties pane.

| Before (`upstream/main` `41b441762`) | After (this PR, `f7d795b0c`) |
|---|---|
| ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/2cef218ca8e9434c1151eb4ad0d194e033d606d7/4008/status-line-before.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/81bad0ef67351469ae3259218e0288d70b98ffbf/4008/status-line-after.png) |
| `OK · 676 moves`. No warning. The clean-up engagement is not measured at the default limit. | `OK · 2246 moves · 1 warning`. The line reads: `warning: clean-up engagement measured 97.5 deg from move 2137, above the 90.0 deg limit - reduce optimal load or increase the engagement limit (the post is not held: the risk is the tool load)`. |

The line is advisory: the status stays `OK` and the post is not held. The move count increases because the clean-up peel steps down.

### Item 8: no new test binary

The six tests of `crates/motion/tests/adaptive_troch_clean.rs` moved into the existing `adaptive_troch_parallel` binary, as the module `crates/motion/tests/adaptive_troch_parallel/clean.rs`. The test code did not change. Only the fixture import changed (`use super::fixtures::*`).

- Why this binary: the Gate map of `adaptive_troch_parallel` already covers `adaptive_troch_clean`, and it uses the same `common/adaptive_troch.rs` fixtures. The motion directory suites (`rest_adaptive`, `rotary_flow`) are for other domains.
- New pin names: `motion adaptive_troch_parallel::clean::<test>` (for example `clean::cleanup_over_the_default_limit_is_named`).
- Result on `f7d795b0c`: 7 passed, 2 ignored (the existing heavy and light twins), 37.6 s.
- Mutation M1 (`CLEANUP_LADDER = &[1.0]`) after the move: `clean::cleanup_steps_down_to_a_custom_limit_wide` and `..._l_shape` fail (refused at 64.0 and 62.5 deg against 60 deg). After the restore, the two tests pass.

These are the heavy tests of the trochoidal generator that this PR changes.

  - `motion adaptive_troch_parallel::clean::cleanup_over_the_default_limit_is_named` (red on main: 118.5 deg with no named warning)

### Earlier findings

The first quick command stopped with signal 15. I ran it again. The counts above are from the completed second run and its remaining steps.
